issues.description: Method SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice: the problem statement requires calculateTotalPrice to be static (shared across saloons), but the reference implementation declares it as an instance method. Problem statement: "The following methods and attributes must be static: ... calculateTotalPrice" (problem_statement.md lines 77-81). Solution: SealSaloon.java declares "public int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)" (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java line 57). This mismatch leaves students uncertain whether to implement calculateTotalPrice as static (so it directly uses the shared static stock) or as an instance method, and it affects how the method is called and taught in examples.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the reference implementation and the problem statement. Preferred fix: make the method static to match the specification — change the signature to "public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)" in SealSaloon and update any call sites (use SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(...) or adjust calls accordingly). Alternatively, if instance semantics are intended, update the problem statement to remove the requirement that calculateTotalPrice must be static and clarify how it should access the shared stock.
